integrity: The general assertions rest on an explicit analytical proof; attached exact-rational checks are finite corroboration. Full original literature was compared for statement-level coverage; residual unindexed specialist literature is possible. No external independent audit has taken place.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns first entrance into either homogeneous state in a neutral, uniformly mixing, symmetric two-allele Moran chain. It does not establish absorption under positive mutation, nor results for spatially varying birth/death, selection, asymmetric mutation, diffusion limits, or post-entrance recurrence. For population size two the distribution does not depend on mutation.
title: Strict all-horizon mutation delay of pure-state entrance in neutral Moran dynamics
